description: This file defines the 'Metadata' interface, which describes a 'Thing' in more detail and provides methods for creating, modifying, and converting metadata objects. It includes static factory methods for creating new instances from JSON and builder patterns for mutable and immutable metadata objects.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: An interface representing metadata associated with a Thing, supporting creation, modification, and JSON conversion.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating or modifying Metadata.

methods.name: newMetadata
methods.description: Creates an immutable Metadata instance initialized with the given JSON object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current Metadata instance's entries.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the Metadata, with overloads for int, long, double, boolean, String, and JsonValue values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField in the Metadata.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields in the Metadata.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry for the specified key.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Metadata to a JsonObject, considering the specified schema version and field selector.
